verdicts.reason: A moves the headline to the top, which works, but it shrinks the Quillbrook logo to a tiny mark in the bottom-left corner that crowds the canvas edge, and squeezes the sticker into a thumbnail-sized box next to the legal line. That breaks brand prominence and leaves the footer cluttered and arbitrary. B keeps the original structure at the slightly narrower size: logo centred at the top, product, headline on one line, CTA and legal text, all with even spacing. Its only flaws are that the sticker sits close to the right edge, as it does in the original, and the legal line is very small.
